{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Boot}}
[[File:PloKoonBoots-TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|boots]]]]
{{Quote|Open mouth...insert boot!|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
A [[Boot/Legends|boot]] was an article of clothing that was placed upon the foot. There were boots that were made for special uses such as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] traveling boots for comfort, or the more sturdy forest boots like the ones worn by the participants of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Types of boots==
[[File:Standard_Boots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A pair of standard boots]]
*'''[[Action boots]], worn by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].
*'''[[Combat boots]], worn by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]
*'''[[Durasteel-toed boots]]''', worn by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]
*'''[[Freeze boots]]''' used by the [[Megonite moss/Legends|megonite]] miners on [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]].
*'''[[Hover boots/Legends|Hover boots]]''' equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] that could raise or lower the wearer.
*'''[[Iridonian field boots]]''' often favored by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].
*'''[[Issued officer boots]]''' given to [[Officer/Legends|officers]].
*'''[[Master-Grav 1000]] [[Repulsor boots|grav boots]]''' by [[Corgorlath Leisure Articles]].
*'''[[R82 Jump Boots/Legends|R82 Jump Boots]]''' that allowed a wearer to fly short distances or to conduct simple gliding.
*'''[[Shock boots]]''' were a standard-issue military boot.
*'''[[Tomuon boots]]''' made of [[tomuon]] leather.
*'''[[Ubese boots/Legends|Ubese boots]]''' used by [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] in conjunction with their armor.

{{Clothes-stub}}
